note: USACE Mobile District, Lake Seminole, at the Georgia-Florida line. Hard-packed level gravel sites with picnic table and fire ring. Sites overlook the lake through trees. --Claude
summary: rec.gov confirms $28 every site (rate seasons 2026-09-30 to 2028; fees now manual, checked 2027), Senior/Access passes accepted, 30/50-amp + water at all 11 sites, all 11 fit 23 ft (24-40 ft), flush toilets/showers/water/dump, reservable on rec.gov, same-day OK, 14 nights in 30. Season left unset: rec.gov says only 'open seasonally' and its rate seasons skip Jul 16 - Sep 29 (a Campendium reviewer quotes the host: closed July 15 - Oct 1), not a statement. Pin OK (~165 m from the site centroid). Note cleaned of field facts.
